title: 111 foreigners in Zamboanga Sibugay Pogo raids flown to Manila

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur, Philippines — The third and final batch of 111 foreign nationals collared during anti-illegal gambling operations in Zamboanga Sibugay last month was transported to Manila early Saturday, Nov. 21, through the Pagadian City Airport, the military confirmed. Maj. Noelio Brigole, spokesperson for the Army’s 1st Infantry Division (1ID), told the Inquirer that the group — composed of 108 Chinese, two Burmese, and one Malaysian — traveled at dawn from Zamboanga Sibugay to this city via a military convoy escorted by agents from the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) and the Bureau of Immigration (BI).
